'''Blast Knuckles''' were a weapon commonly rigged together by [[Outlaw tech/Legends|Outlaw techs]] in the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].<ref name="DC" />

==Characteristics==
Consisting of a heavy, armored [[Glove/Legends|glove]] with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] built into the back of wearer's hand, blast knuckles had impact-sensitive plating across the knuckles that activated this blaster whenever the wearer landed a punch.<ref name="DC" /> The result was an explosive punching glove that delivered a devastating point-blank blast.<ref name="DC" /> Undeniably effective, the armor plating of the glove protected the wearer from the detonations just [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] from their fingers; despite this, using blast knuckles was quite taxing, and very few users embraced the danger inherent with such a weapon.<ref name="DC" />
